prompt: Photograph of an irrigation service scene with no people present: an open green valve box set in a green lawn with its lid leaning beside it, and a clean row of tools and replacement parts laid out on the grass next to it - pipe cutter, channel-lock pliers, a coil of black poly tubing, several new black sprinkler heads and a handful of brass fittings.
